html:
Nurse at home in Tashkent: services, prices, and benefits

Healthcare is one of the most essential parts of life, but not everyone has the time, energy, or ability to visit a hospital or clinic. Whether you are an expat living in Uzbekistan, a medical tourist, or a local resident in Tashkent, the option to call a nurse at home in Tashkent can be a lifesaver.
Home nursing services bring professional medical care directly to your door. From simple injections to IV therapy, wound care, blood tests, or elderly support, trained nurses provide quality healthcare in the comfort of your home. This guide will walk you through everything you need to know: services available, average prices, benefits, and how to book a nurse at home in Tashkent.

Why choose a nurse at home in Tashkent?

1. Convenience and time-saving
No more waiting in long hospital queues or spending hours in traffic. With a nurse at home, you get care at your preferred time.
2. Safety and comfort
Avoid exposure to infections or hospital stress. Home care provides medical help in your personal space.
3. Personalized attention
A dedicated nurse focuses only on you, ensuring proper treatment and follow-up.
4. Accessibility for vulnerable patients
Elderly, post-surgery patients, and those with mobility issues can easily receive healthcare without leaving home.

What services do home nurses provide in Tashkent?

1. Injections at Home (Intramuscular or Intravenous)

  • Antibiotic injections
  • Vitamin therapy
  • Pain relief injections

4. Wound Dressing and Post-Operative Care

  • Wound cleaning and bandaging
  • Post-surgical monitoring
  • Burn or injury care

2. IV Therapy at Home

  • Hydration therapy
  • Vitamin drips
  • Recovery and detox treatments

3. Blood Tests at Home

  • Safe and professional blood sample collection
  • Sent to certified laboratories
  • Results delivered electronically

5. Elderly and Long-Term Care

  • Daily injections or IV management
  • Monitoring blood pressure and glucose
  • Assistance with mobility and medication schedules

6. Child and Mother Care

  • Pediatric injections and checkups
  • Postnatal mother care
  • Vaccinations (when prescribed)

Average prices for home nurse services in Tashkent

While prices may vary depending on service type, urgency, and distance, here are average estimates:

  • Injections at home: 5–10 USD
  • IV therapy (drip): 10–15 USD
  • Blood test collection: 6–10 USD (lab costs separate)
  • Wound dressing: 8–12 USD
  • Elderly care per visit: 10–20 USD
  • Private nurse full-day care: 30–50 USD

With OnlaynHamshira, you can see prices in advance and book easily via website or app.

How to book a nurse at home in Tashkent

1. Visit OnlaynHamshira.uz or download the app.
2. Choose the required service (injection, IV, blood test, wound care, or nursing support).
3. Enter your location and preferred time.
4. Confirm the booking and make payment (cash, card, or online).
5. A licensed nurse arrives at your home to provide the service.

Who needs a nurse at home in Uzbekistan?

  • Expats living in Tashkent who prefer English/Russian-speaking medical support at home.
  • Elderly patients who cannot travel frequently to clinics.
  • Patients after surgery who require regular monitoring and injections.
  • Parents with small children who want safe medical services at home.
  • Busy professionals who value time and prefer convenient care.

Benefits of using OnlaynHamshira

  • Verified nurses with medical qualifications and licenses.
  • Multi-language support (Uzbek, Russian, English).
  • Fast response – nurses usually arrive within 1–2 hours.
  • Transparent pricing – no hidden charges.
  • Secure and professional – trusted by hundreds of families in Tashkent.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. How quickly can a nurse arrive at my home?

Usually within 1–2 hours depending on your location in Tashkent.

2. Are the nurses licensed professionals?

Yes, all nurses are certified and experienced in home medical care.

3. Can I request specific services like IV vitamins?

Yes, IV drips and vitamin therapy are available, but only if prescribed by a doctor.

4. Can nurses bring the required medications?

Some medications are provided by the nurse, while others (especially prescription drugs) must be supplied by the patient.

5. Is it safe to do blood tests at home?

Absolutely. Nurses use sterile equipment and send samples to certified labs.

Why this service is growing in Tashkent

Home nursing is not only convenient but also essential in a fast-developing city like Tashkent. With more expats, medical tourists, and locals seeking high-quality care, the demand for home nurse services in Uzbekistan is increasing rapidly.
Healthcare is becoming digital, and platforms like OnlaynHamshira make it easy to connect patients with qualified nurses instantly.

Conclusion

If you are searching for nurse at home in Tashkent, IV therapy at home, or injections at home Uzbekistan, OnlaynHamshira is your trusted partner. Whether you need post-surgery care, help for elderly relatives, or quick medical assistance, professional nurses are just a click away.
